A '''sonic beam weapon''' was used by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. It contained a high-frequency screamer chip, emitter and power cell.

Boba Fett's sonic beam weapon projected a high-frequency screech that caused intense pain, leaving targets stunned and deafened. The device was short-ranged and reached out to 6 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The weapon's power cell was only able to provide enough charge for three uses before it had to be recharged.<ref name="SWRPG CRB" />
